title: World Generation: Colossal Caverns, Aquifers, and Mountain Spires
summary: Descend into massive 3D subterranean cave networks featuring glowing amethyst geodes, underground lakes, and soaring jagged peaks.

content: Our custom 3D noise router with SIMD AVX2 acceleration generates immense vertical depth spanning [-1024, 2048). Discover multi-tier subterranean caverns with cheese and noodle caves, flooded aquifers, magma chambers at mantle depths, and lush glowing underground flora.
